title: Search
nothingFound: Nothing found. Could you try another word?

page.title: Search
page.subtitle: Tasks, notes, meetings, partners and the words inside your files, in one box.
page.noResultsBody: Could you try another word? Turkish letters do not matter.
page.noResultsAsk: Try another word, or ask Claude; it searches by meaning.
page.modeBoth: Searched by words and by meaning.
page.modeKeywordOnly: Searched by words. Meaning search turns on once a Voyage key is added.
page.tipTurkishBody: Typing “cocuk isciligi” finds “Çocuk İşçiliği”, and “rapor” also covers “raporlarımız”.
page.tipInsideBody: Words in PDF, Word and Excel files are searched too, and a result opens the right page.
page.tipAskBody: For a question like “What did Partner B say about the budget?”, Claude answers from your own records and shows its sources.
page.loose: Nothing has all the words; showing results with some of them.

ask.title: Ask
ask.subtitle: Ask your files, notes and meetings. Claude answers only from your own records and shows the source of every point.
ask.placeholder: Type a question and press Enter…
ask.noCitations: This answer cites no source; your records may not cover it.
ask.noHistory: You have not asked anything yet.

examples.0: What did we decide about the budget in recent meetings?
examples.1: How many households do the partner reports say were reached?
examples.2: When were field visits planned for the harvest season?

ask.privacy: Files and notes marked “Kept away from AI”, and files with a child-data warning, are never sent to Claude.
ask.nothingTitle: I found nothing about this question
ask.nothingBody: Could you ask with other words? Or look with keyword search.
ask.notConnectedBody: Once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is added, your questions are answered with sources. Meanwhile you can use keyword search.
